by.sh: The username of the item's author

dead.sh: true if the item is dead

deleted.sh: true if the item is deleted

descendants.sh: In the case of stories or polls, the total comment count

kids.sh: The ids of the item's comments, in ranked display order

parent.sh: The comment's parent: either another comment or the relevant story

parts.sh: A list of related pollopts, in display order

score.sh: The story's score, or the votes for a pollopt

text.sh: The comment, story or poll text.

time.sh: Creation date of the item, in Unix Time

title.sh: The title of the story, poll or job.

items.sh: Array of item IDs that have been updated

profiles.sh: Array of usernames whose profiles have been updated

created.sh: Creation date of the user, in Unix Time

submitted.sh: List of the user's stories, polls and comments

ratelimit.title: Client-side rate limiting via a token bucket

retry.title: Automatic retry of transient failures with exponential backoff

test.title: In-memory mock transport for testing without a live server
